items.text:
I so badly want to give this a 10/10 but I've encountered a fatal bug which doesn't allow me to open my airlocks on returning to my ship - even with character allowed to use airlocks selected.

Makes me very sad.

*** Developer literally released a patch and the bug was addressed on the day. This makes me super happy.

11/10 !
items.text_zh:
我太想给这个打10/10了，但我遇到了一个致命bug，导致我返回飞船时无法打开气闸——即使已经选中了允许角色使用气闸的选项。

让我非常难过。

*** 开发者真的发布了一个补丁，当天就解决了这个bug。这让我超级开心。

11/10！
